name: waf
description: Web Application Firewall management: enable Coraza with the OWASP Core Rule Set, switch between detection and blocking mode, and review recent WAF events.
author: nself

actions.enable: Enable the WAF in detection mode
actions.mode: Switch between detection and blocking mode

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. `nself plugin install waf` must place the built nself-waf binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-waf, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself waf <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/waf.go under CLI-R11. WAF is Security-Always-Free per the nSelf PPI doctrine, so this stays a free MIT plugin even though CLI-R11 is otherwise mostly extracting paid/advanced command families.
